PGFldvKUqS.one_liner: Splits diffusion training trajectories into orthogonal population and empirical directions, then penalizes motion along an estimated direction (DAO).
PGFldvKUqS.problem: Over-parameterized diffusion models trained on limited data generalize early and then memorize, but a quantitative characterization of the geometry and dynamics of this transition is lacking.
PGFldvKUqS.method: They show the denoiser-output training trajectory decomposes into two directions tied to the population and empirical distributions, orthogonal in expectation, and that it first moves toward the population Bayes-optimal denoiser and then turns sharply toward the empirical Bayes-optimal one as memorization emerges. They also analyze the spectrum of the denoiser output-space training kernel and propose Direction-Aware Orthogonal (DAO) regularization, which selectively penalizes denoising motion along an estimated direction.
PGFldvKUqS.key_idea: Split the denoising trajectory into orthogonal population and empirical directions, then penalize motion along an estimated direction, using the finding that the population direction is learned through faster kernel modes.
PGFldvKUqS.evidence: Synthetic and real-world datasets showing a phase transition in the denoising trajectory, plus a spectral analysis of the denoiser output-space training kernel.

UqYarTBVar.one_liner: Models grokking tasks as Latin colourings and proves when all minimum-norm solutions generalize from partial observations.
UqYarTBVar.problem: Prior grokking work focuses on the delay before generalization, leaving open which tasks make every minimum-norm solution generalize from partial observations.
UqYarTBVar.method: They model pairwise input tasks as edge colourings of K_{q,q} with Latin colourings as the structured family, and classify each observed instance as all-good, mixed, or no-good by its set of minimum-norm endpoints. They prove finite-abelian-group families are asymptotically all-good, while all-good tasks become asymptotically rare under a uniform random Latin square for observation-based learners.
UqYarTBVar.key_idea: Classify observed Latin-square instances by whether all, some, or no minimum-norm endpoints generalize, treating the post-fit weight-decay solution as the object of study.
UqYarTBVar.evidence: Two asymptotic theorems, experiments showing that relabellings of addition generalise, and finite-training results on composite-order tasks suggesting predictors learn a coarse part of the output first.

t62keNF6Zx.one_liner: Feed-forward 4D instance segmentation via persistent object queries in a space-time decoder, plus an agentic language-grounding harness
t62keNF6Zx.problem: Existing Segment Anything models work on 2D images or video masks and keep identity through sequential memory, while promptable 4D instance segmentation on feed-forward visual geometry is underexplored.
t62keNF6Zx.method: From RGB observations, a space-time query decoder turns shared visual-geometric features into class-agnostic 4D instance masks, with each persistent object query binding one entity across all observations, supporting prompt-independent, point and box prompting. An agentic harness adds active tree search over frames, a dual-stream grounder combining VLM bounding boxes with object-query matching, and an independent critic.
t62keNF6Zx.key_idea: Persistent object queries decode shared visual-geometric features into 4D instance masks, each query binding one entity across all observations without needing a seed mask or temporal ordering.
t62keNF6Zx.evidence: Experiments on 4D instance segmentation and language grounding; the visible abstract is truncated, and datasets and baselines are not stated.

dcRuxDiEIM.one_liner: Tuning-free densest k-subgraph solver using minorization-maximization with a degree-adaptive separable minorizer over the capped simplex
dcRuxDiEIM.problem: Densest k-subgraph is NP-hard, and its continuous relaxation is non-convex with stationary points of very unequal quality.
dcRuxDiEIM.method: The solver builds on the diagonally loaded relaxation over the capped simplex, with a proof that light loading keeps the graph in control of the search direction. F^3-DkS uses minorization-maximization with separable minorizers indexed by weights, each maximized in closed form over the capped simplex and ascending monotonically to a KKT point, and a degree-adaptive member needs no tuning.
dcRuxDiEIM.key_idea: Use MM with separable minorizers whose weights select the stationary point, and set them from vertex degrees, giving closed-form monotone updates without tuning.
dcRuxDiEIM.evidence: Theory on tightness below the clique number and monotone ascent to KKT points; experimental datasets and baselines are not stated in the visible abstract.

WcUj2Wloi5.one_liner: EB-Decode commits clusters of low-entropy tokens early in diffusion LLMs using learned variable-length blocks and a parallel sampler.
WcUj2Wloi5.problem: Diffusion LLMs need many steps before token confidence reaches the decoding threshold, so inference is inefficient even with block-wise KV caching.
WcUj2Wloi5.method: A learnable network groups tokens with similar uncertainty into variable-length blocks, and a position-aware sampler learns to unmask tokens in parallel with fewer steps inside predicted blocks. Both are plug-ins that leave pretrained dLLM weights unchanged.
WcUj2Wloi5.key_idea: Tokens with similarly low entropy cluster, so lightweight routers predict variable-length blocks and decode them jointly before reaching the confidence threshold.
WcUj2Wloi5.evidence: Experiments across three models and four benchmarks.
WcUj2Wloi5.claimed_gains: 3.53-18.76x higher throughput than vanilla decoding with comparable accuracy, and up to 1.58x higher throughput than a second comparison whose name is cut off in the abstract.

MssIoMeGST.one_liner: MUSE-Bench tests whether LLM agents use cross-session memory beyond recall, across Comprehension, Apply and Evaluation abilities.
MssIoMeGST.problem: Existing memory benchmarks test accurate recall of memory content, yet 83.7% of memory-dependent WildChat queries invoke memory while solving downstream tasks, which goes untested.
MssIoMeGST.method: Using Bloom's taxonomy, they define three higher-order memory abilities and build MUSE-Bench with a need-first construction pipeline: 100 user profiles over 12 life domains and 3,840 queries across six tasks. The Evaluation level adds two failure modes, Interference Memory and Counterfactual Query.
MssIoMeGST.key_idea: Derive benchmark scenarios from annotated real memory-dependent queries and grade memory use by Bloom's taxonomy levels, including cases where memory must be suppressed or must correct a query.
MssIoMeGST.evidence: Annotation of WildChat (21,382 memory-dependent queries) and evaluation of 14 frontier LLMs on the 3,840-query benchmark.

XfHOVkE9yo.one_liner: Dataset of 1,079 purchasable real objects with scanned geometry, articulation, physical properties and manipulation annotations, built by a real-to-sim pipeline.
XfHOVkE9yo.problem: Existing resources provide either scan-derived real-world appearance or simulation metadata, but rarely both for large-scale purchasable objects needed in robotic manipulation.
XfHOVkE9yo.method: RoboPhyScan aligns high-fidelity scanned geometry, reconstructed texture, precise articulation, physical properties and manipulation annotations (part pose, affordance, grasp pose) for 1,079 instances across 65 object types. An efficient real-to-sim assetization pipeline reduces active human production time to approximately 60 minutes per asset on average.
XfHOVkE9yo.key_idea: Pair scanned real purchasable objects with simulation-ready articulation, physics and grasp annotations through a real-to-sim assetization pipeline needing about 60 minutes of human time per asset.
XfHOVkE9yo.evidence: Assets are evaluated for visual quality, sim-ready stability and utility in downstream robotic applications.
XfHOVkE9yo.claimed_gains: 1,079 purchasable object instances across 65 object types, with active human production time reduced to approximately 60 minutes per asset on average.

bzjcuc7VqV.one_liner: Anneals the sampling temperature from high to low during generation, exploring early tokens and exploiting late ones, for RLVR rollouts.
bzjcuc7VqV.problem: Fixed-temperature sampling in RLVR cannot balance sample quality and training stability, since high temperatures degrade sample quality and low temperatures limit discovery.
bzjcuc7VqV.method: Exploratory Annealed Decoding (EAD) lowers the sampling temperature from high to low during generation, giving diversity at early tokens and then keeping the sampling distribution close to the target policy. It is a lightweight plug-and-play rollout strategy.
bzjcuc7VqV.key_idea: Anneal the decoding temperature within each rollout from high to low, because exploration matters most on early tokens that set a sequence's semantic direction.
bzjcuc7VqV.evidence: Mathematical reasoning tasks across various RLVR algorithms and model sizes, compared with fixed-temperature sampling.
bzjcuc7VqV.claimed_gains: Consistently outperforms fixed-temperature sampling across RLVR algorithms and model sizes and significantly improves sample efficiency; no numbers stated.

LclbQDEggR.one_liner: Trains a latent-conditioned RL generator with reverse curriculum and success-gated diversity to produce diverse demonstrations for imitation learning.
LclbQDEggR.problem: Behavior cloning for robotic manipulation is sensitive to training-data coverage, yet collecting diverse successful demonstrations is costly.
LclbQDEggR.method: DiscoDemo trains a privileged latent-conditioned RL generator using a parallel reverse curriculum and a success-gated diversity objective. Its multiple successful closed-loop behaviors are safety-filtered and exported as a static dataset for downstream visuomotor imitation learning.
LclbQDEggR.key_idea: Use RL as a data generator whose latent-conditioned policy is rewarded for diversity only when the task succeeds.
LclbQDEggR.evidence: Four manipulation tasks in simulation and on a real robot, with a pretrained flow-matching VLA as the downstream imitation policy.
LclbQDEggR.claimed_gains: Averaged across tasks, downstream success increases to 62% from 40% for the strongest baseline in simulation, and to 77% from 36% on the real robot.

ZubGTNlvqH.one_liner: A large generative model supplies sparse keyframe references to a lightweight video transformer, tuned by RL with video-level rewards.
ZubGTNlvqH.problem: Large generative models recover realistic detail in real-world video super-resolution but are too expensive to run over a whole video, and keyframe errors can propagate and accumulate across output frames.
ZubGTNlvqH.method: Sparse Generative Relay has a large generative model produce reference latents for sparse keyframes while a lightweight Dual-Memory Video Transformer super-resolves every frame from those references and the low-resolution video. Video-Aware Reference Optimization (VARO) updates the large model with RL using a system-level reward on videos from the fixed lightweight network and a reference-level reward on decoded keyframes.
ZubGTNlvqH.key_idea: Optimize the keyframe generator with RL using both system-level video rewards and reference-level keyframe rewards while the lightweight VSR network stays fixed.
ZubGTNlvqH.evidence: Comparisons show VARO beats direct joint training and dual-level rewards beat a system-level reward alone; efficiency is measured at 1080p on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB.

L7Wb1kiRMq.one_liner: Multi-agent visible-infrared video fusion that detects degradation transitions and merges degradation-specific task vectors into segment-specific fusion parameters.
L7Wb1kiRMq.problem: Existing visible-infrared video fusion methods use fixed fusion parameters and struggle with dynamic degradations whose types and severities change over time.
L7Wb1kiRMq.method: A Sentinel Agent localizes degradation transitions and an Expert Agent predicts continuous multi-label degradation severities from dual-modal bursts. A Fusion Mixer merges degradation-specific task vectors into segment-specific fusion parameters, and a Feedback Agent detects local fusion failures and triggers re-diagnosis and re-fusion.
L7Wb1kiRMq.key_idea: Compose degradation-specific task vectors in parameter space, weighted by predicted severities, to generate fusion parameters for each video segment.
L7Wb1kiRMq.evidence: Experiments on fusion quality, temporal consistency, and downstream tracking, plus a newly built 20K dual-modal burst-level instruction dataset used to customize the Expert Agent.
L7Wb1kiRMq.claimed_gains: Reports improved fusion quality, temporal consistency, and downstream tracking performance; no numbers are stated.

KuoHhKvV9P.one_liner: Monitors lm_head gradient norm to stop rollout reuse in RLVR before policy shift degrades performance.
KuoHhKvV9P.problem: Reusing rollout batches for multiple gradient updates amplifies policy shift in RLVR and degrades performance, and detecting the onset early enough to stop reuse is unsolved.
KuoHhKvV9P.method: Dynamic Gradient Gating (DGG) monitors the lm_head gradient norm in real time and intercepts harmful updates. It is motivated by the Disproportionate Weight Divergence phenomenon, where degradation coincides with a sharp surge in lm_head weight change while intermediate layers stay stable.
KuoHhKvV9P.key_idea: Use the lm_head gradient norm, which lower-bounds policy divergence, as a real-time signal to gate gradient updates on reused rollouts.
KuoHhKvV9P.evidence: Empirical checks that the lm_head weight surge appears across diverse LLMs and tasks, plus proofs that harmful gradients concentrate at lm_head and that its gradient norm lower-bounds policy divergence (abstract truncated before DGG results).

rxMdxBI6Ez.one_liner: Benchmark of 222 instances testing whether coding agents can build interactive simulators from embodied videos.
rxMdxBI6Ez.problem: Building interactive simulators from real-world observations still relies on manual environment construction and calibration.
rxMdxBI6Ez.method: Video2World frames autonomous video-to-simulation as a software engineering task: an agent observes an embodied video, builds the simulated environment and robot behavior, and refines it through execution feedback. It scores worlds on geometric fidelity, dynamic fidelity, and functional correctness.
rxMdxBI6Ez.key_idea: Evaluate coding agents end to end on reconstructing executable simulated worlds from robot and human demonstration videos, scored on geometry, dynamics, and function.
rxMdxBI6Ez.evidence: 222 reconstruction instances from 189 robot and human demonstration videos, evaluating 9 frontier coding-agent systems.
rxMdxBI6Ez.claimed_gains: Task success rises from below 5% to over 15% beginning with Claude Opus 5, with substantial gaps to human-assisted reconstruction remaining.

76wocnPAme.one_liner: Recovers missing views with multi-view rectified flow and uses contrastive learning and dual-graph structure for incomplete multi-view, missing multi-label classification.
76wocnPAme.problem: In incomplete multi-view missing multi-label classification, missing views break view-specific distribution structure (Representation Bias Problem) and incomplete labels give weak or wrong supervision, so errors amplify each other (Coupling Error Propagation).
76wocnPAme.method: CEE recovers missing views and preserves view-specific distribution structure through multi-view rectified flow learning, adds multi-view structure reinforcement that uses contrastive learning for cross-view semantic consistency, and designs a collaborative dual-graph structure (abstract truncated) to exploit sample-level and label-level structure.
76wocnPAme.key_idea: Combine rectified-flow view recovery, contrastive cross-view consistency and sample-level plus label-level graph structure to break the coupled loop of representation bias and label error.
76wocnPAme.evidence: Not stated; the abstract is truncated before any datasets, baselines or results.

5wBwtkMpII.one_liner: Two-stage RL framework teaching reasoning models to solve briefly, abstain early, or reason deeply based on rollout-derived solvability.
5wBwtkMpII.problem: Efficiency methods read pass rate as difficulty and leave the zero-return regime unmodeled, so they overspend on queries beyond the model's capability and compress hard-but-solvable ones.
5wBwtkMpII.method: BET combines behavioral cold-start with GRPO under an investment-cost-aware reward, aligning solve-or-fold decisions with rollout-derived solvability. The model learns short solve for easy queries, nice fold (early abstention when expected return is near zero) and hero call (enough compute for hard-but-solvable queries).
5wBwtkMpII.key_idea: Allocate reasoning budget by the expected return of further reasoning, estimated from the model's own rollouts, using a cost-aware GRPO reward that allows abstention.
5wBwtkMpII.evidence: Seven benchmarks and three base models, plus zero-shot transfer to scientific QA and logical reasoning.
5wBwtkMpII.claimed_gains: Reduces reasoning tokens by 54% while improving accuracy by up to 3.2% across seven benchmarks and three base models.

MjSR1GFfKw.one_liner: Stores each reusable RAG chunk once as an INT4 base KV with per-request INT4 replacement overlays merged in composite attention.
MjSR1GFfKw.problem: In high-fanout RAG, per-request KV cache ownership replicates document state and consumes memory even after quantization, exact prefix sharing only covers byte-identical prefixes, and cache-fusion systems do not encode shared state and query-conditioned repairs as jointly executable low-bit objects.
MjSR1GFfKw.method: OneBaseKV stores each chunk once as an immutable INT4 canonical base and represents query-sensitive differences with private INT4 replacement overlays at positions chosen by an architecture-normalized selector. Materialization-equivalent composite attention merges base, overlay, and dynamic KV through one global online softmax without a persistent dense request cache.
MjSR1GFfKw.key_idea: Share one immutable low-bit base KV per chunk, patch query-sensitive positions with private overlays, and merge all parts in a single online softmax equivalent to attention over the materialized KV.
MjSR1GFfKw.evidence: A proof of exact equivalence to standard attention over the materialized dequantized KV with a mixed-partition perturbation bound, and experiments comparing efficient methods under fixed persistent-KV budgets (the abstract is cut off).
MjSR1GFfKw.claimed_gains: not stated; the visible abstract says OneBaseKV achieves the best quality among the compared efficient methods under fixed persistent-KV budgets, without numbers.

vgtizm0RIC.one_liner: Proves hardness of polynomial-time CCE computation in discounted Markov games and gives layered optimistic mirror descent with sub-exponential convergence.
vgtizm0RIC.problem: It is unclear whether radically uncoupled learning can efficiently reach coarse correlated equilibria in discounted general-sum Markov games.
vgtizm0RIC.method: Under the ETH for PPAD assumption, they prove that no deterministic polynomial-time algorithm computes discounted CCEs as uniform mixtures of product Markov profiles within polynomial support. They then give a radically uncoupled algorithm based on a layered variant of optimistic mirror descent with an increasing step-size schedule, under full and partial feedback.
vgtizm0RIC.key_idea: Layered optimistic mirror descent with an increasing step-size schedule gives radically uncoupled sub-exponential convergence to CCE, alongside an ETH-for-PPAD hardness result.
vgtizm0RIC.evidence: Theoretical results only as visible in the abstract: a hardness theorem under ETH for PPAD and convergence guarantees under full-feedback and partial-feedback settings.
vgtizm0RIC.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract gives qualitative guarantees (sub-exponential convergence to CCE) without numbers.

RpMnjATifl.one_liner: Sets the spectral cutoff of training-free recommenders from a graph-conditioned estimate of the noise spectrum's upper edge.
RpMnjATifl.problem: Training-free spectral recommenders depend on where the user-item graph spectrum is cut, and the best retained dimension varies widely across graphs, so a fixed rank does not transfer.
RpMnjATifl.method: CalibCF derives a graph-conditioned noise-spectrum template from a separable user-item degree variance profile, then fits its scale to the observed squared singular values with a one-parameter regression after excluding leading signal directions. It sets the cutoff relative to the estimated edge and applies a continuous, closed-form shrinkage response to the retained directions, with a consistency proof under a degree-corrected Bernoulli graph model.
RpMnjATifl.key_idea: Fit a degree-derived noise-spectrum template to the observed singular values to locate the noise edge, then set the cutoff relative to it and apply closed-form shrinkage.
RpMnjATifl.evidence: Five benchmarks (best retained dimension spans 114-1,869), spectral heads covering only 4.9-10.4% of the spectrum, a consistency proof under a degree-corrected Bernoulli graph model, and template predictions of uncomputed eigenvalue distributions (abstract cut off).
RpMnjATifl.claimed_gains: not stated; the visible abstract gives no accuracy gains, only that the best retained dimension spans 114-1,869 across five benchmarks and spectral heads cover 4.9-10.4% of the spectrum.

0h3CZLWS71.one_liner: Organizes agent memory as specificity-ordered hierarchies in Lorentz hyperbolic space, with entailment cones marking where exceptions apply.
0h3CZLWS71.problem: Existing memory systems treat coexisting general facts and conditional exceptions as conflicts resolved by recency or similarity, so the record that applies to the current query image can be discarded or outranked.
0h3CZLWS71.method: ConeMem places general facts near the origin of the Lorentz model and exceptions in branching entailment cones; an observer on frozen vision-language encoders maps the image region chosen by a condition text into the same space, making record selection a geometric test with no language model call. A local write procedure reinforces a fact, opens a branch, or waits for recurrence.
0h3CZLWS71.key_idea: Embed memories as nested entailment cones in hyperbolic space so choosing the applicable record becomes a geometric containment test.
0h3CZLWS71.evidence: A proof that negative curvature lets nested cones share a bounded radial range, and a leave-one-benchmark-out evaluation (benchmarks not visible in the truncated abstract).

jtM9g6ixWG.one_liner: Generation-aware reconstruction probes decoders on partially noised-and-denoised latents, giving a diagnostic that correlates with gFID and enabling decoder adaptation.
jtM9g6ixWG.problem: Reconstruction FID can correlate weakly or negatively with generation FID because reconstruction runs the decoder on encoder-induced latents while generation runs it on latents from the generative model.
jtM9g6ixWG.method: GAR builds a continuous trajectory from reconstruction toward generation by perturbing encoder latents with noise and denoising them through the generative model before decoding. GAR-FID summarizes this trajectory, and intermediate GAR latents keep correspondence to their source images, giving paired supervision for decoder adaptation.
jtM9g6ixWG.key_idea: Perturb encoder latents with noise and denoise them through the generative model to expose the encoder-to-generation latent shift while keeping image correspondence for decoder adaptation.
jtM9g6ixWG.evidence: Diverse tokenizers and scales for the GAR-FID versus gFID correlation, and decoder adaptation tested across model scales.
jtM9g6ixWG.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract says only that GAR-FID correlates strongly with gFID and that decoder adaptation consistently improves generative quality, without numbers.

a13x7esw55.one_liner: Exact characterization of the factorized edge shows Factorized AdaBoost.MH converges at AdaBoost.MH's rate, removing the dimension-dependent slowdown.
a13x7esw55.problem: Factorized AdaBoost.MH converges only if a vote vector with large enough induced binary weight mass can always be chosen, and the earlier lower bound max{1/n, 1/sqrt(2K)} leaves a dimension-dependent slowdown relative to AdaBoost.MH.
a13x7esw55.method: Sharpens the combinatorial step by proving an exact value for the minimax quantity W_{n,K} governing the factorized edge, W_{n,K} = C_{min{n+1,K}}, with explicit formulas for C_q by parity of q.
a13x7esw55.key_idea: Compute the exact minimax value of the factorized edge combinatorially, showing it stays bounded below by a constant uniformly in n and K.
a13x7esw55.evidence: Theoretical proofs only; no experiments are stated.
a13x7esw55.claimed_gains: W_{n,K} = C_{min{n+1,K}} with C_q decreasing to 1/3, so W_{n,K} = Theta(1) uniformly over n and K, and Factorized AdaBoost.MH matches AdaBoost.MH's convergence rate (the abstract is cut off after "up").

nXsjEplCAo.one_liner: GPS synthesizes identity-consistent hard positives by compressing, merging, and vanishing patch tokens for aerial-ground person re-identification.
nXsjEplCAo.problem: Aerial-ground person re-identification must match identities across large changes in local appearance and visibility, but existing methods do not construct identity-preserving cross-view variations with controllable difficulty.
nXsjEplCAo.method: A Geometry-Constrained Patch Synthesizer reorganizes patch tokens by compression, merging, and vanishing using a fixed spatial prior; a hard-positive module picks the hardest consistent candidate in a difficulty range; a dual-path module fuses original and synthetic evidence.
nXsjEplCAo.key_idea: Synthesize feature-level hard positives by geometry-guided token compression, merging, and vanishing, select the hardest within a difficulty range, and fuse supported correspondence with original evidence.
nXsjEplCAo.evidence: Four aerial-ground benchmarks with component analysis, compared against a plain CLIP baseline.
nXsjEplCAo.claimed_gains: Consistent improvements over Plain CLIP across all evaluated protocols on four aerial-ground benchmarks; no numbers stated.

e30l0LI2IS.one_liner: OmniAgent is a training-free agent that plans unimodal tool calls, using audio cues to localize events for audio-video reasoning.
e30l0LI2IS.problem: Omnimodal LLMs struggle with fine-grained cross-modal understanding and alignment, and prior workflows are rigid and rely on dense frame captioning.
e30l0LI2IS.method: The agent uses dynamic planning to invoke specialized unimodal tools on demand, with a coarse-to-fine audio-guided perception paradigm that localizes temporal events from audio before further reasoning.
e30l0LI2IS.key_idea: Plan tool calls on demand and use audio cues to localize temporal events first, then spend perception only on the task-relevant segments.
e30l0LI2IS.evidence: Three audio-video understanding benchmarks, compared with open-source and closed-source models, without training.
e30l0LI2IS.claimed_gains: Surpasses leading open-source and closed-source models by 10% - 20% accuracy without training on three audio-video benchmarks.

m1uIwHm445.one_liner: Reconstructs Gärdenfors-style conceptual spaces from LLM representations and tests alignment with human conceptual organization.
m1uIwHm445.problem: Existing representation hypotheses each capture one level of conceptual abstraction, with no unified account of LLM conceptual geometry.
m1uIwHm445.method: Proposes the Gärdenforsian Representation Hypothesis (GRH) covering quality dimensions, domains, properties (adjectives), category concepts and prototypes, and tests it by progressively reconstructing the conceptual space from LLM representations.
m1uIwHm445.key_idea: Recover quality dimensions, domains, properties, categories and prototypes in stages from LLM representations, treating prior representation hypotheses as instances at different abstraction levels.
m1uIwHm445.evidence: Experiments on THINGSplus and Binder comparing the recovered geometry with human conceptual organization.
m1uIwHm445.claimed_gains: The recovered conceptual geometry closely aligns with human conceptual organization; no numbers stated.

7jtaXiCnT3.one_liner: Benchmark of Godot gameplay-logic tasks checked by deterministic tick-level state assertions, validated against mutants and alternative correct implementations.
7jtaXiCnT3.problem: Existing game-development benchmarks replay fixed examples, score videos or use model judges, so none checks game rules throughout execution across varied scenarios with reproducible verdicts.
7jtaXiCnT3.method: GameLogicBench has 72 gameplay-logic tasks in Godot projects, with an automated evaluator that checks rules at every simulation tick across 403 hand-designed scenarios and seeded variations giving 1,451 test cases. The evaluator must accept different correct implementations while rejecting mutants that lack one required capability.
7jtaXiCnT3.key_idea: Assert game rules at every simulation tick over seeded scenarios, validating the evaluator by accepting varied correct implementations and rejecting single-capability-removed mutants.
7jtaXiCnT3.evidence: 20 combinations of language models and scaffolds, including twelve models under Claude Code across task scopes.
7jtaXiCnT3.claimed_gains: The best observed run solves 52.78% of tasks, and under Claude Code all twelve models solve fewer tasks as scope grows from isolated mechanics to repository-scale features.

I8cNz62wYh.one_liner: Models a pretrained vision transformer's feature space with a diffusion transformer on compressed spherical latents, decoded by existing heads.
I8cNz62wYh.problem: Pretrained encoders such as VGGT and Depth Anything V2 have task heads for structured outputs, but their feature spaces are not used directly as targets for text-conditioned generation.
I8cNz62wYh.method: MIRAGE compresses encoder tokens with a hybrid VAE onto a product of spheres with log-normal radii, then trains a diffusion transformer with rectified flow that follows geodesics on each sphere and a straight path in log-radius, using REPA alignment against the encoder itself.
I8cNz62wYh.key_idea: Compress encoder features onto a product of spheres with log-normal radii and run geodesic rectified flow, decoding samples with the encoder's existing heads.
I8cNz62wYh.evidence: Four geometric encoders (VGGT, PAGE-4D, Depth Anything V2, DUSt3R) with initial audio experiments, compared with raw-feature diffusion baselines at two scales.
I8cNz62wYh.claimed_gains: Latents are 16-64x smaller than raw-feature diffusion baselines while remaining within 1-6% in depth-FVD (the remaining results are truncated in the abstract).

ku0iV9SIB4.one_liner: Benchmark and omni-modal model for spatial audio-visual perception and sound-guided navigation, using an FOA spatial encoder plus semantic audio pathway.
ku0iV9SIB4.problem: It is unclear how to evaluate and model spatial audio understanding, such as localizing a sound source and combining it with visual cues, for embodied agents.
ku0iV9SIB4.method: OmniEchoBench has six tasks over 197 real-world spatial audio-visual scenes, 2,972 QA pairs and 900 navigation samples with first-order ambisonics audio from 30 environments, plus a controllable spatial-audio rendering pipeline for training supervision. OmniEcho adds an FOA spatial encoder alongside a pretrained semantic audio pathway.
ku0iV9SIB4.key_idea: Pair a first-order-ambisonics spatial encoder with a pretrained semantic audio pathway in an omni-modal model, trained on geometrically consistent rendered spatial audio.
ku0iV9SIB4.evidence: Experiments on OmniEchoBench spatial audio-visual perception tasks and on sound-guided navigation with real-recorded FOA audio.
ku0iV9SIB4.claimed_gains: not stated (the abstract claims state-of-the-art spatial audio-visual perception and an initial navigation baseline, without numbers).

TnEbK1fFpq.one_liner: RoboFL installs client LoRA adapters as experts of a server MoE and aggregates them through routing distillation and expert consensus.
TnEbK1fFpq.problem: Robot interaction data is scarce, siloed and task-heterogeneous, and naive federated aggregation of adapters entangles incompatible updates while MoE routing can dilute specialization and destabilize expert selection.
TnEbK1fFpq.method: MoSAIC directly installs locally trained LoRA adapters as expert branches of a server MoE, whose routers learn token assignments while jointly refining routing and expert parameters. Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation (FARD) aligns routing across the model's three paths, and Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation (PCEA) compresses expert updates into a compact global adapter for personalized redistribution.
TnEbK1fFpq.key_idea: Use each client's LoRA adapter as a prior-informed expert slot in a server-side MoE and align routing across the three paths by distillation.
TnEbK1fFpq.evidence: Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RLBench and a real-world Franka robot arm, compared with centralized PEFT InternVLA-A1.
TnEbK1fFpq.claimed_gains: Outperforms centralized PEFT InternVLA-A1 by 12.23% on the Franka arm; the abstract is cut off before the second claimed gain.

DvbMbRTNte.one_liner: An MLP that learns its depth, width and parameters jointly by backpropagation, with no fixed upper bounds.
DvbMbRTNte.problem: Neural network architecture is fixed during training and inference, and discrete architectural changes are not differentiable, so networks cannot self-organize their structure.
DvbMbRTNte.method: SOAP makes the addition and removal of layers and neurons compatible with the gradient signal, so depth, width and parameters are learned jointly by standard backpropagation; the network is formally infinite but practically finite, in the style of Bayesian models.
DvbMbRTNte.key_idea: Make adding and removing layers and neurons gradient-compatible so the training signal sets depth and width, with no imposed upper bounds, in the style of Bayesian models.
DvbMbRTNte.evidence: Six tabular datasets, plus analyses of how depth and width respond to batch size and starting conditions; keywords mention variational inference.
DvbMbRTNte.claimed_gains: Maintains or exceeds MLP performance on 6 tabular datasets; no other numbers stated.

hRVP83NSZw.one_liner: Runs a low-frequency video DiT world planner and a high-frequency action DiT linked by observation-guided context routing.
hRVP83NSZw.problem: Existing world-action models couple world prediction and action execution at the same temporal resolution, forcing the world branch to model redundant near-term frame variations.
hRVP83NSZw.method: AHA-WAM uses a dual Diffusion Transformer: the video DiT is a low-frequency planner with rolling key-value memory and layerwise latent context, and the action DiT executes short action chunks in closed loop by querying that context through layerwise joint attention. Horizon-adaptive offset training and Observation-Guided Video-Context Routing support asynchronous execution.
hRVP83NSZw.key_idea: Decouple temporal rates so a slow long-horizon video planner exposes reusable layerwise context that a fast action expert queries, with routing guided by current observations.
hRVP83NSZw.evidence: not stated (the abstract is cut off before experiments; keywords indicate robot learning and embodied manipulation).

kpcp40UgGj.one_liner: Meta-learns a skill Writer initialization that adapts to new task-Reader pairs through Reader feedback and text refinement.
kpcp40UgGj.problem: Existing methods optimize a skill or its construction prompt for a fixed Reader, without learning a Writer whose construction process adapts quickly to new task-Reader pairs.
kpcp40UgGj.method: MetaSkill meta-learns a Writer initialization for coupled parameter-text adaptation: Reader feedback temporarily specializes the Writer's parameters, and text refinement externalizes that specialization into a persistent skill.
kpcp40UgGj.key_idea: Meta-train a Writer so a few Reader-feedback parameter updates followed by text refinement yield a skill tailored to a given task-Reader pair.
kpcp40UgGj.evidence: Language, reasoning and interactive benchmarks, comparing meta-learned, original and multitask-trained Writers, with ablations of both stages and tests on unseen Reader families.
kpcp40UgGj.claimed_gains: not stated; adaptation is described as far more effective from the meta-learned initialization, and it matches the strongest text-space optimizer on non-interactive tasks at lower token cost.

tKtFDcetwK.one_liner: Trains an energy-based model by regressing its negative gradient onto a frozen transport teacher's velocities, plus contrastive refinement.
tKtFDcetwK.problem: Energy Matching fits energy gradients to stochastic transport targets whose variance degrades the training signal at scale.
tKtFDcetwK.method: Train a time-independent transport teacher, freeze it, then fit the negative energy gradient to the teacher's predicted velocities. Contrastive refinement shapes the landscape near the data manifold.
tKtFDcetwK.key_idea: Replace stochastic transport targets with a frozen teacher's deterministic velocity predictions as regression targets for the negative energy gradient.
tKtFDcetwK.evidence: CIFAR-10 gradient-noise analysis and FID comparison with Energy Matching; latent-space 3D CT generation against flow models with the same backbone; sparse-view cone-beam CT reconstruction against a flow prior trained on the same data.
tKtFDcetwK.claimed_gains: not stated (abstract is qualitative: lower FID than Energy Matching on CIFAR-10, FID competitive with flow models on 3D CT, better reconstruction than a flow prior).

GXnuYMnUzM.one_liner: DOVAS periodically reweights sampling over fixed data regions using optimizer-aligned estimates of each update's predicted benefit.
GXnuYMnUzM.problem: Static offline scoring or inference-time visual-dependence measures for multimodal instruction data cannot quantify how an example's gradient update will benefit the current, evolving model.
GXnuYMnUzM.method: DOVAS partitions the instruction corpus into fixed, semantically stratified regions, combines offline visual-evidence scoring with online optimizer-aligned utility estimation, and periodically re-weights regional sampling probabilities by estimating the predicted impact of candidate optimizer updates without changing region membership.
GXnuYMnUzM.key_idea: Re-weight sampling probabilities of fixed semantic regions during training using the estimated impact of candidate optimizer updates on the current model.
GXnuYMnUzM.evidence: Standard multimodal instruction-tuning benchmarks across multiple model families, compared with static data-selection baselines and with full-dataset training.
GXnuYMnUzM.claimed_gains: Using only half of the full-data training compute budget, it surpasses the performance of full-dataset training across multiple model families.

d0EKZmaQCX.one_liner: Zero-HLM builds digital twins from smartphone captures and synthesizes whole-body demonstrations in simulation for zero-shot humanoid loco-manipulation.
d0EKZmaQCX.problem: Generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation is bottlenecked by costly real-world demonstrations, and simulation needs scene-scale, visually faithful, physics-ready environments plus successful demonstrations under unified whole-body control.
d0EKZmaQCX.method: Zero-HLM couples Gaussian visual reconstruction with agentic physical scene construction to build interaction-ready digital twins. A motion-environment co-adaptation strategy synthesizes unified whole-body references and uses rollout feedback to restore interaction geometry when tracking deviations disrupt execution.
d0EKZmaQCX.key_idea: Co-adapt whole-body motion references and environment geometry using rollout feedback inside Gaussian-reconstructed, physically aligned digital twins to generate validated demonstrations.
d0EKZmaQCX.evidence: 4,800 physically validated simulation demonstrations, zero-shot transfer to a Unitree G1 on three long-horizon tasks with GR00T N1.7, comparison with real-data training under matched configurations, and generalization tests (abstract truncated).
d0EKZmaQCX.claimed_gains: Generates 4,800 validated demonstrations averaging a 1.8x speedup over real-world data collection, and with GR00T N1.7 simulation-only training achieves 66.7% mean full-task success with an absolute 20% gain over real-data training.

GOPoXWnJQx.one_liner: Hybrid Forcing adds linear temporal attention and block-sparse local attention to streaming video generation, distilled in decoupled stages.
GOPoXWnJQx.problem: Sliding window attention in distilled streaming video generators loses distant history in long videos, and its computational overhead hinders real-time deployment.
GOPoXWnJQx.method: Lightweight linear temporal attention keeps a compact key-value state that incrementally absorbs evicted tokens, and block-sparse attention is applied inside the local sliding window. A decoupled distillation first runs few-step distillation under dense attention, then activates distillation of the linear temporal and block-sparse attention.
GOPoXWnJQx.key_idea: Absorb tokens evicted from the sliding window into a compact linear-attention key-value state, and distill the sparse hybrid attention only after a dense-attention few-step distillation.
GOPoXWnJQx.evidence: Short-video and 30-second VBench-Long benchmarks; the abstract is truncated before the results.

AUmtOiMvCa.one_liner: InstaPoint assigns each instance its own mask-based extent supervision using density calibration and prediction-guided selection.
AUmtOiMvCa.problem: Point annotations give neither object scale nor orientation, and the reliability of complementary mask-based supervision sources varies per instance, so a patch-wise source choice can be unsuitable when isolated and clustered objects coexist.
AUmtOiMvCa.method: Instance Density Calibration gives prediction-independent initial assignments from local spatial configuration. Instance-wise Supervision Assignment then selects, for each instance, the candidate supervision most consistent with the detector's current prediction and keeps it for the rest of training.
AUmtOiMvCa.key_idea: Initialize each instance's supervision source from local density, then reassign it to the candidate most consistent with the detector's current prediction and keep it fixed.
AUmtOiMvCa.evidence: Experiments on the DIOR-R and DOTA-v1.0 remote-sensing datasets; the abstract is truncated before accuracy results.
AUmtOiMvCa.claimed_gains: not stated (the visible abstract gives only that ISA revises the initial supervision source for 47.62% of instances on DIOR-R and 42.99% on DOTA-v1.0).

YYo95o7Z0S.one_liner: WireForge conditions low-poly mesh generation on editable 2D wireframes from an image-model agent via spatial anchors and cross-attention.
YYo95o7Z0S.problem: Low-poly mesh generation is underdetermined, and matching the input geometry does not guarantee that edges follow salient structures.
YYo95o7Z0S.method: A wireframe-generation agent, WirePilot, built on off-the-shelf image-generation models, generates, evaluates and refines candidate wireframes. WireForge associates wireframe features with spatial anchors derived from the input mesh, applies 3D positional encoding, and guides mesh generation through cross-attention alongside surface-sample geometry.
YYo95o7Z0S.key_idea: Lift 2D wireframe features onto spatial anchors from the input mesh with 3D positional encoding and inject them via cross-attention to steer edge layout.
YYo95o7Z0S.evidence: Experiments are mentioned but the abstract is truncated; datasets, backbones and metrics are not stated.

5jpHtVgle7.one_liner: GenFirst jointly trains a VAE and latent generator end-to-end with an entropy-preserving objective, shaping generation before refining reconstruction.
5jpHtVgle7.problem: Reconstruction-optimized VAE latents are not necessarily generation-friendly, and direct end-to-end joint training is prone to latent collapse and a generation-reconstruction conflict.
5jpHtVgle7.method: The authors find that the entropy term in the KL objective prevents collapse and that reconstruction is fast while generation is slower and harder to optimize. They use an entropy-preserving end-to-end objective and the GenFirst strategy, which first shapes a generation-friendly latent space and then refines reconstruction.
5jpHtVgle7.key_idea: Keep the KL entropy term to prevent collapse, and train generation first to shape the latent space before refining reconstruction, exploiting their asymmetric learning dynamics.
5jpHtVgle7.evidence: Exact-likelihood continuous autoregressive priors and SiT-based flow-matching priors on ImageNet-256, MMDiT on text-to-image generation, and an extension to shared visual latents (abstract truncated).
5jpHtVgle7.claimed_gains: SiT achieves a gFID of 0.97 with CFG and 1.45 without CFG on ImageNet-256, and MMDiT reaches a GenEval score of 0.90 on text-to-image generation.

9FXOBkzgGS.one_liner: StreamEgo distills an Exo2Ego video diffusion model into a chunk-wise autoregressive generator for real-time streaming.
9FXOBkzgGS.problem: Existing exocentric-to-egocentric video generation methods degrade manipulation regions, overfit, and are confined to fixed-length clips with prohibitive latency.
9FXOBkzgGS.method: A streaming dual-branch prior gives pixel-aligned guidance for translating appearance and skeletal kinematics, and a region-aware loss curriculum stabilizes multi-objective diffusion training. The model is then distilled into a chunk-wise autoregressive model with a region-aware corruption mechanism and a first-chunk curriculum.
9FXOBkzgGS.key_idea: Combine a dual-branch appearance-and-skeleton prior with a region-aware loss curriculum, then distill into a chunk-wise autoregressive model trained with region-aware corruption.
9FXOBkzgGS.evidence: Not stated beyond real-time generation speed on a single H100 GPU; benchmarks and baselines are not named in the abstract.
9FXOBkzgGS.claimed_gains: Real-time streaming Exo2Ego generation at 24.3 FPS on a single H100 GPU.

C7hVClbaoS.one_liner: TAG recalibrates SAM3 concept recognition with image-conditioned low-rank adapters trained from image-level labels and MLLM distillation.
C7hVClbaoS.problem: SAM3 delineates the objects it recognizes accurately but struggles to determine which concepts are present, so concept recognition rather than mask quality limits downstream segmentation.
C7hVClbaoS.method: TAG adds an Anchor Residual Pathway of image-conditioned low-rank adapters that re-ground text anchors in the target distribution, trained with binary cross-entropy plus Soft Boundary Ranking objectives on image-level category labels to calibrate presence confidence. Confidence-Weighted Distillation couples a multimodal LLM's semantic context with SAM3's spatial priors.
C7hVClbaoS.key_idea: Re-ground text anchors with image-conditioned low-rank adapters, calibrate presence confidence with ranking against confusable negatives, and distill MLLM semantics weighted by confidence.
C7hVClbaoS.evidence: An empirical diagnosis that concept recognition is SAM3's bottleneck; downstream benchmarks and results are truncated in the abstract.

We9x9Twodv.one_liner: ActTune picks per-call layer-wise precision and GPU frequency for VLA inference using an action recognizer and workload forecast.
We9x9Twodv.problem: Repeated VLA policy calls make GPU energy a recurring cost, and cutting energy per call may not cut energy per successful task if numerical errors raise failures or slower inference lengthens episodes.
We9x9Twodv.method: A lightweight recognizer selects precision before each policy call, a controller forecasts the next workload and applies GPU settings asynchronously from a lookup table calibrated under a latency budget, and a shared resident quantized weight bank switches configurations without weight reconstruction.
We9x9Twodv.key_idea: Link layer-wise precision allocation, chosen by recognized action class, with workload-dependent GPU frequency selection, since precision changes the favorable GPU operating point.
We9x9Twodv.evidence: LIBERO benchmark, compared with BF16 implementations and state-of-the-art VLA baselines; the abstract is truncated before the energy results.
We9x9Twodv.claimed_gains: On LIBERO, ActTune with the evaluated selector improves mean task success by up to 2.4% relative to state of the art; the energy reduction relative to BF16 is truncated in the abstract.

wY6ZNJYfEE.one_liner: SimDFKs evolves divergence-free kernel parameters under PDEs to simulate incompressible 2D and 3D fluids without training data.
wY6ZNJYfEE.problem: Resolving multiscale flow structures needs spatial representations that are both expressive and efficient, and divergence-free kernels had been used for flow reconstruction but not forward simulation.
wY6ZNJYfEE.method: The paper extends divergence-free kernels to forward simulation with a reformulation that makes evolving the continuous representation under PDEs practical and stable. An optimization-based framework evolves kernel parameters under advection, external forces and boundary conditions while preserving incompressibility by construction.
wY6ZNJYfEE.key_idea: Represent the flow as a superposition of divergence-free kernels and evolve their parameters by optimization under the PDE, so incompressibility holds by construction.
wY6ZNJYfEE.evidence: Forward simulations of various 2D and 3D fluid phenomena from given initial conditions without precomputed training data; the abstract also mentions simulation recovery (truncated).

F7WOprbcat.one_liner: Action-Timing trains search agents with STOP/CONTINUE decisions supervised by counterfactual rollouts estimating continuation's marginal utility.
F7WOprbcat.problem: Multi-turn search agents stop too early with incomplete evidence or keep searching after evidence suffices, and a standard rollout reveals only the outcome of the chosen action, not the counterfactual.
F7WOprbcat.method: Action-Timing is a cost-aware RL framework with an explicit STOP/CONTINUE decision. It uses main-trajectory branches with matched same-action and counterfactual rollouts organized in a knowledge-state graph to estimate the Marginal Utility of Continuation, and gives continuation plans credit relative to the same stopping reference.
F7WOprbcat.key_idea: Estimate the Marginal Utility of Continuation as the difference in expected cost-adjusted utility between continuing and stopping from the same decision context, using counterfactual rollouts.
F7WOprbcat.evidence: Experiments on search-agent benchmarks and trajectory analyses of bidirectional timing correction; specific benchmarks and baselines are not named.

9QiNnUO3Fu.one_liner: Adaptive directed-relation weighting plus a view curriculum for multi-label cross-modal hashing over paired, image-only and text-only inputs.
9QiNnUO3Fu.problem: Existing hashing methods assume fixed image/text input configurations, while practical systems may need to handle paired, image-only and text-only inputs, which makes optimization difficulty heterogeneous and changing across nine directed relations.
9QiNnUO3Fu.method: Relation weights are estimated from raw contrastive statistics to calibrate multi-label contrastive learning, and the learned relation states guide sampling of paired, image-only and text-only views for later training.
9QiNnUO3Fu.key_idea: Estimate per-relation weights from raw contrastive statistics and reuse the learned relation states to drive curriculum sampling of paired, image-only and text-only views.
9QiNnUO3Fu.evidence: COCO, NUS-WIDE and MIRFlickr25K across multiple hash-code lengths and eight directed retrieval protocols.

MhiweC44cB.one_liner: GenComp generalizes layer-wise adaptive gradient compression across error space, error measure, and measurement frequency.
MhiweC44cB.problem: Layer-wise adaptive compression schemes typically measure error by L2 distance in gradient space on a fixed measurement schedule.
MhiweC44cB.method: GenComp varies three axes: whether compression error is measured on gradients or on latent activations obtained by simulating gradient updates and forward passes, which error measure is used, and how often it is measured.
MhiweC44cB.key_idea: Measure compression error on simulated post-update activations as well as gradients, with alternative error measures and adjustable frequency, to set per-layer compression levels.
MhiweC44cB.evidence: Sparsification, quantization and low-rank compression schemes applied to different model architectures, compared with recent layer-wise adaptive schemes.
MhiweC44cB.claimed_gains: not stated (the abstract claims higher compression ratios at similar performance and reduced end-to-end training time for larger models, without numbers).

oNYugauLxX.one_liner: ReferClaw asks cost-aware clarifying questions to resolve ambiguous egocentric queries before answering, with three cooperating agents.
oNYugauLxX.problem: Users of egocentric assistants ask short, ambiguous questions whose referents cannot be uniquely resolved from video and dialogue history, and existing VideoQA systems commit to a single interpretation.
oNYugauLxX.method: Three cooperating agents identify candidate interpretations, request clarification, and generate answers grounded in the resolved intent and visual evidence, under a bounded cost-aware policy balancing expected information gain against user effort. It learns from verified interaction feedback through intent-specific skill updates and process-reward-guided policy optimization with agent-level credit assignment.
oNYugauLxX.key_idea: Trade off expected information gain against user effort in a bounded clarification policy, and learn from interaction feedback via skill updates and process-reward-guided policy optimization.
oNYugauLxX.evidence: Augmented egocentric QA benchmarks measuring answer accuracy and joint answer-and-grounding performance, plus zero-shot transfer across datasets and a comparison with adaptation baselines given full annotated feedback.

USUwQ8a7CV.one_liner: ALDIPPO replaces PPO's clip with an alpha-divergence penalty on the importance ratio, with online updates of alpha from batch statistics.
USUwQ8a7CV.problem: PPO's performance is sensitive to larger clipping thresholds and deeper policy networks, and clipping switches off gradients for out-of-range samples, wasting the rollout budget spent to collect them.
USUwQ8a7CV.method: ALDIPPO replaces the clip with an alpha-divergence penalty on the importance ratio, which is stiffer for samples outside the epsilon range, and uses several online update rules for alpha based on on-policy batch statistics.
USUwQ8a7CV.key_idea: Penalize the importance ratio with an alpha-divergence whose alpha is updated online from on-policy batch statistics, instead of clipping and zeroing gradients.
USUwQ8a7CV.evidence: MiniGrid environments, MuJoCo tasks and the Procgen benchmark, compared with PPO.
USUwQ8a7CV.claimed_gains: not stated (the abstract says ALDIPPO beats PPO from MiniGrid to MuJoCo and generalizes better on Procgen, without numbers).

zeF9icNjFd.one_liner: OverSeer augments egocentric multi-agent video world models with fixed auxiliary camera views compressed by a delta-VAE.
zeF9icNjFd.problem: Extending video world models to multiple agents requires generating several agent-specific video streams that are consistent over time and between agents.
zeF9icNjFd.method: OverSeer adds auxiliary camera views fixed in space to the agents' egocentric views, as a proxy for a world-centric representation. A delta-VAE encodes only changes relative to a static reference image, reducing the number of tokens needed for these views.
zeF9icNjFd.key_idea: Fixed-position auxiliary views map changes directly to localized world-state changes, and a delta-VAE tokenizes only differences from a static reference image to cut token count.
zeF9icNjFd.evidence: The abstract states that fixed views help maintain consistency and that the delta-VAE reduces tokens, without naming datasets or metrics.

dmFif2smra.one_liner: FastEraser distills an effect-aware video object-removal model into few steps using dense-to-sparse attention discrepancy and RGB-space supervision.
dmFif2smra.problem: Generation-based effect-aware video object removal is costly because of billion-scale models and iterative denoising, and mask-guided sparsity, step reduction, or CFG-reliant Distribution Matching Distillation do not fit CFG-free removal models.
dmFif2smra.method: Sparsity-Driven Distillation introduces a dense-to-sparse attention discrepancy between real and fake score models, playing the role of CFG-induced asymmetry in few-step distillation without restricting removal to the input mask. Pixel Reconstruction Loss decodes the student's denoised latent through a frozen VAE and supervises it directly in RGB space against the ground-truth video.
dmFif2smra.key_idea: Use the dense-versus-sparse attention gap between real and fake score models in place of CFG asymmetry for distribution-matching distillation, plus an RGB-space reconstruction loss.
dmFif2smra.evidence: Not stated in the visible abstract, which is truncated after describing the Pixel Reconstruction Loss.

hFFtgj9Fn3.one_liner: Chronofy jointly generates dynamic objects and camera-space poses from single-view videos by extending SAM3D to 4D.
hFFtgj9Fn3.problem: Generative reconstruction methods work for static 3D content but show pronounced inter-frame jitter on dynamic content.
hFFtgj9Fn3.method: Built on SAM3D, Chronofy uses a pose-aware 4D representation that encodes frame-dependent motion in spatiotemporal structured latents with a unified sequence-level pose, a spatiotemporal mixture-of-transformers generator, and a dynamic Gaussian decoder with time-varying attributes. Temporal masking augmentation and layout test-time optimization handle occlusion and multi-object alignment.
hFFtgj9Fn3.key_idea: Transfer SAM3D's generative priors to 4D with spatiotemporal structured latents and a unified sequence-level pose, decoded by dynamic Gaussians whose attributes vary over time.
hFFtgj9Fn3.evidence: Experiments on Motion-80, Kubric-4D and a simulated real-world Chrono-64 dataset for 4D object generation and 4D scene reconstruction.

nnD2pkTDXf.one_liner: GUIDE builds identity graphs on patch geometry shared across RGB, NIR and thermal modalities, then reads out ordered axial strips.
nnD2pkTDXf.problem: Graph-based multi-modal ReID derives topology from feature or semantic similarity, so corresponding regions across modalities aggregate different context and identity-related structural cues become less consistent.
nnD2pkTDXf.method: A Grid Graph Encoder restores patch tokens to their 2D layout and propagates local identity cues over geometry-defined neighborhoods with a graph encoder shared across modalities. An Axial Strip Readout aggregates graph-refined tokens into ordered strips with learnable queries, and the structured representations complement global semantic features.
nnD2pkTDXf.key_idea: Define graph connectivity by patch geometry rather than feature similarity, so the relational topology is decoupled from modality-dependent appearance.
nnD2pkTDXf.evidence: Three multi-modal ReID datasets (RGB, NIR, thermal), compared with previous methods on mAP.
nnD2pkTDXf.claimed_gains: Improves mAP by up to 10.7 points over previous methods on three datasets.

xLAAiixRoc.one_liner: WINGS inpaints Gaussian splatting scenes in the embedding space of a 3D-native generative prior, without 2D reference views.
xLAAiixRoc.problem: Gaussian splatting inpainting that relies on 2D diffusion to produce inpainted reference views suffers from multi-view inconsistency and lengthy optimization.
xLAAiixRoc.method: The method uses the embedding space of a large pre-trained 3D prior with a structure completion network that feeds a generative prior, which reconstructs the missing region's geometry and appearance natively in 3D.
xLAAiixRoc.key_idea: Complete the masked region's structure and generate its content inside a pre-trained 3D-native generative prior's latent space, avoiding reconciliation of multiple inpainted 2D references.
xLAAiixRoc.evidence: Qualitative and quantitative experiments and a user study, compared with 2D-based inpainting methods; datasets and metrics are not stated.
xLAAiixRoc.claimed_gains: not stated (the abstract claims higher perceptual quality and multi-view consistency with comparable or faster runtime, without numbers).

vK8YBnFc2m.one_liner: Pretrains per-frame register tokens on a multi-view covisibility task so register attention scales to long-sequence 3D reconstruction.
vK8YBnFc2m.problem: Global attention in feed-forward reconstruction transformers has quadratic cost in views and patches, and prior register-attention alternatives report a significant accuracy drop.
vK8YBnFc2m.method: The registers are pretrained on a multi-view covisibility pretext task, extended from a two-view static setting to long dynamic sequences with a new view-conditioned, query-based segmentation head, before finetuning on 3D reconstruction. Only a few tokens per frame are exchanged across views.
vK8YBnFc2m.key_idea: Pretrain register tokens on covisibility segmentation across long dynamic sequences, so cross-view register attention approaches global attention after finetuning.
vK8YBnFc2m.evidence: Comparisons with global attention and chunked global attention on sequences of hundreds of views; datasets are not stated.
vK8YBnFc2m.claimed_gains: Recovers most of the global attention performance, is an order of magnitude faster than global attention, and outperforms chunked global attention on hundreds of views; no exact numbers are stated.

uwvjLYM6CR.one_liner: ReCUE supervises cross-modal matching with support counted across the K lowest-cost one-to-one assignments, revising correspondences as representations evolve.
uwvjLYM6CR.problem: In weakly supervised visible-infrared person re-ID, early errors in provisional cross-modal matches can distort the representation and be reinforced in later correspondence inference.
uwvjLYM6CR.method: Global Correspondence Hypothesis Inference enumerates the K lowest-cost feasible one-to-one assignments and scores each candidate match by its frequency across them. Structural Uncertainty-Aware Learning gives hard targets to highly supported matches, soft targets to ambiguous ones and no positive supervision to weakly supported ones, while Correspondence-Representation Co-Evolution periodically rebuilds the correspondence state.
uwvjLYM6CR.key_idea: Use each candidate match's frequency across the K lowest-cost global assignments as its support to set hard, soft or no supervision, and periodically recompute all correspondences.
uwvjLYM6CR.evidence: SYSU-MM01 and LLCM experiments; the abstract is truncated before results.

eQ5cOaZkYO.one_liner: MVPR learns modality-specific positional residuals and uses text prompts to align aerial views to ground views for any-scenario person re-ID.
eQ5cOaZkYO.problem: Transformer methods for any-scenario person re-ID share positional embeddings across sensing modalities, ignoring modality-dependent spatial cues and body-part layout changes caused by aerial-ground viewpoint shifts.
eQ5cOaZkYO.method: Modality-Aware Positional Residual Correction learns modality-specific positional residuals injected as differences between consecutive layer-specific residuals in a shared visual encoder. Text-Guided View Alignment uses learnable text prompts to supervise paired forward passes with the correction disabled and enabled, using aerial- and ground-view anchors for aerial images and ground anchors for ground images.
eQ5cOaZkYO.key_idea: Add layer-wise modality-specific positional residuals to a shared encoder, and align aerial images toward ground-view text anchors by contrasting passes with and without the residuals.
eQ5cOaZkYO.evidence: Experiments on WHU-MARS-1000 compared with UAD; the abstract is truncated before the margin.

ItTH1nQI0c.one_liner: TCM estimates the probability a stored memory is still valid from its transition context via a discrete-time invalidation hazard.
ItTH1nQI0c.problem: Agent memory can retrieve, time-place and revise records, but cannot tell whether a retrieved observation is still true before a contradiction appears, and no function of age alone is calibrated when memory types expire at different rates.
ItTH1nQI0c.method: Transition-Calibrated Memory reads a memory's transition context into a discrete-time invalidation hazard and integrates it over elapsed time into a probability of current validity. A cost-optimal rule then prices that probability into using or verifying the memory.
ItTH1nQI0c.key_idea: Map a memory's transition context to a discrete-time invalidation hazard, integrate over elapsed time into current validity, and threshold it with a cost-optimal use-or-verify rule.
ItTH1nQI0c.evidence: Human re-query judgments (TicToc), two intensive-care cohorts and an exact-event simulator, including a matched 20% verification budget and a context-permutation control.
ItTH1nQI0c.claimed_gains: Cuts the worst group-calibration gap of age-only rules from 0.358 to 0.197 on TicToc, and earns 0.05 to 0.09 more harm-weighted utility than the strongest baseline at a matched 20% verification budget (abstract truncated after this).

UNz3iuVVbo.one_liner: Conflux distills an autoregressive VLM and a continuous flow model on-policy into a unified discrete diffusion LLM.
UNz3iuVVbo.problem: Unified discrete diffusion LLMs for visual understanding and generation must inherit the strengths of autoregressive VLMs and continuous flow models, and conventional masked diffusion corrupts a clean image token directly to an uninformative mask token.
UNz3iuVVbo.method: A cross-paradigm on-policy distillation framework transfers visual understanding from autoregressive VLMs and visual generation from continuous flow models into a unified DLLM. A progressive self-refining diffusion process gradually corrupts each token across multiple steps during training, so inference can soft-commit to tokens and refine them.
UNz3iuVVbo.key_idea: Distill on-policy from autoregressive and flow teachers into one DLLM, and gradually corrupt each token across steps instead of masking it, enabling soft commits and self-refinement at inference.
UNz3iuVVbo.evidence: Experiments on visual question answering, multi-modal reasoning, object grounding, text-to-image generation and image editing; datasets and baselines are not named.
UNz3iuVVbo.claimed_gains: not stated (the abstract claims the best results among unified DLLMs across these tasks, without numbers).

lCtpemmPim.one_liner: PhysHuman jointly generates human-object interaction video and dynamics by predicting actuator torque as an auxiliary target.
lCtpemmPim.problem: HOI video models optimize RGB fidelity while overlooking physical plausibility, producing interpenetrations, implausible impulses, and motions that do not vary coherently with physical settings.
lCtpemmPim.method: A diffusion-based video model conditioned on a text prompt and first frame predicts actuator torque as an auxiliary target, learning structured dynamics without torque supplied as input. The authors also build PhysHuman-Dataset (PHD) in simulation by executing HOI policies while sweeping object mass, with synchronized RGB, depth, actuation traces, geometry and physical-parameter annotations.
lCtpemmPim.key_idea: Add actuator-torque prediction as an auxiliary output of a diffusion video model so it learns structured dynamics, trained on simulated HOI data with swept object mass.
lCtpemmPim.evidence: Evaluations of physics consistency using the simulation-built PHD; specific metrics and baselines are not stated.

AzuFuajTaV.one_liner: Envision4D predicts future camera poses and lifts conditioned motion in a feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting model for future extrapolation.
AzuFuajTaV.problem: Feed-forward Gaussian Splatting methods designed for scene interpolation suffer ghosting under large displacements when extended to future extrapolation, and rely on simplified motion assumptions or strict future priors.
AzuFuajTaV.method: A Future Pose Prediction module infers future camera parameters by iterative refinement, In-layer Temporal Attention and Conditioned Motion Lifting capture non-linear dynamics, and a Progressive Training Strategy stabilizes unsupervised motion learning against error accumulation.
AzuFuajTaV.key_idea: Infer future camera poses by iterative refinement and convert uncertain extrapolation into relational mappings through conditioned motion lifting with in-layer temporal attention.
AzuFuajTaV.evidence: Experiments on future view synthesis for autonomous driving; datasets and metrics are not stated.

bHmLRAbsow.one_liner: ReMoM casts motion-guided few-shot VOS as matching SAM 3 masklets to support-defined motion through track-to-way relation modeling.
bHmLRAbsow.problem: Motion-guided few-shot video object segmentation requires matching motion between support and query videos despite appearance and execution-style variation, while SAM 3's object representations rely heavily on appearance cues.
bHmLRAbsow.method: ReMoM formulates the task as motion-centric masklet matching, performing support-conditioned matching through explicit track-to-way relation modeling over masklets extracted by SAM 3. Counterfactual temporal enhancement strengthens temporal evidence, and context from surrounding objects resolves interaction-dependent ambiguities.
bHmLRAbsow.key_idea: Match SAM 3 masklets to support motion via explicit track-to-way relations, strengthened by counterfactual temporal enhancement and surrounding-object context.
bHmLRAbsow.evidence: Experiments on the MOVE and A2D-Motion benchmarks.
bHmLRAbsow.claimed_gains: Outperforms prior models by 17.5% on MOVE.

GZXTFZwnXP.one_liner: Introduces EventTree and WildEvent-1K, a 538K-video hierarchical event classification dataset, with a generative VLM baseline GHVC.
GZXTFZwnXP.problem: Existing video classification datasets are built around predefined actions or objects, whereas in-the-wild categories vary widely in subjects, scenes and appearance and can be visually similar yet semantically distinct.
GZXTFZwnXP.method: EventTree is a human-in-the-loop framework that discovers and organizes event categories from large video collections by top-down taxonomy construction, yielding WildEvent-1K with a three-level taxonomy. GHVC is a baseline that classifies via next-token prediction with a pretrained VLM, predicting level by level and restricting each prediction to valid children in the taxonomy.
GZXTFZwnXP.key_idea: Build the dataset by human-in-the-loop top-down taxonomy construction and classify with a VLM by next-token prediction, one taxonomy level at a time, restricted to valid children.
GZXTFZwnXP.evidence: WildEvent-1K with 538K videos and 1,040 event categories in a three-level taxonomy, described as having intra-class variation, a long-tailed distribution and subtle differences between neighboring categories; GHVC baseline results are truncated.

Jn2Vq1iyPC.one_liner: AReA applies cross-scale coarse attention early and shrinking-window local attention later in DiT denoising, training-free.
Jn2Vq1iyPC.problem: Generating images beyond a DiT's training resolution is hard because token count grows quickly, full attention is expensive, and uniform full attention exposes the model to more tokens and longer relative distances than seen in training, causing structural distortions and degraded detail.
Jn2Vq1iyPC.method: AReA lets the attention receptive field evolve from coarse to fine following denoising: early steps use cross-scale coarse attention over downsampled keys and values for global context, and later steps use local attention within progressively shrinking windows. It adds no parameters or training.
Jn2Vq1iyPC.key_idea: Match attention's receptive field to the denoising stage, using coarse attention over downsampled keys and values early and progressively shrinking local windows later.
Jn2Vq1iyPC.evidence: Experiments across target resolutions and different models compared with training-free baselines; specific models and metrics are not stated.

FWXkieRZzd.one_liner: Scales continuous diffusion LM embeddings to T5Gemma-2 and distills them into a student encoder using soft labels.
FWXkieRZzd.problem: Raw text embeddings are overly discriminative, so continuous diffusion often ends at an invalid embedding between plausible alternative words.
FWXkieRZzd.method: They search over embeddings and find that scaling up to T5Gemma-2 embeddings greatly improves generation. They then distill T5Gemma-2 into a student encoder trained on the teacher's decoded probabilities as soft labels, which pulls alternative-word embeddings closer while keeping the encoding-decoding mechanism.
FWXkieRZzd.key_idea: Train a student encoder on the teacher's decoded token probabilities as soft labels so embeddings of plausible alternative words move closer together.
FWXkieRZzd.evidence: An embedding search for continuous diffusion language models, with a medium-sized DLM evaluated on OpenWebText against GPT-2-M as an autoregressive counterpart.
FWXkieRZzd.claimed_gains: A medium-sized DLM reaches Gen. PPL 17.8 (real-text PPL 15.4) at real-text entropy on OpenWebText, outperforming GPT-2-M.

KwZMjt6Da8.one_liner: Learns per-agent responsibility shares of a common Lagrange multiplier to select higher-welfare equilibria under a shared MARL cost budget.
KwZMjt6Da8.problem: A common Lagrange multiplier enforces an aggregate budget but does not decide how the penalty is allocated across agents, and uniform or agent-specific multipliers each have drawbacks.
KwZMjt6Da8.method: LiRA (Lagrangian Responsibility Allocation) learns each agent's share of a common multiplier by optimizing social welfare over a finite training horizon; the multiplier enforces the aggregate budget while the shares redistribute its influence without changing rewards or constraints. A welfare gradient accounts for both learning updates and the induced change in data distribution.
KwZMjt6Da8.key_idea: Split the shared multiplier into a common strength and learnable per-agent shares, trained by a welfare gradient that includes the induced data-distribution shift.
KwZMjt6Da8.evidence: Theory for convex games showing the shares induce a smooth family of normalized generalized Nash equilibria, plus experiments on CityLearn, MABIM, Harvest, and MetaDrive with 3 to 400 agents.
KwZMjt6Da8.claimed_gains: LiRA improves average social welfare by up to 29% over uniform and agent-specific multiplier baselines while grid and driving costs remain within budget.

S4NN33LI06.one_liner: Proves fine-grained gap-dependent regret and local switching cost bounds for UCB-Bernstein+ with variance-based bonuses in tabular online RL.
S4NN33LI06.problem: Fine-grained gap-dependent analysis exists for model-free RL with Hoeffding-type bonuses but not for model-free algorithms with variance-based exploration bonuses.
S4NN33LI06.method: They analyze UCB-Bernstein+, a refined UCB-Bernstein algorithm, to obtain a fine-grained gap-dependent regret bound for episodic tabular MDPs. Adding a stage-wise policy update design and refined variance-based bonuses yields a gap-dependent local switching cost bound.
S4NN33LI06.key_idea: Combine a stage-wise policy update with refined variance-based bonuses inside a fine-grained gap-dependent analysis framework.
S4NN33LI06.evidence: Theoretical upper bounds for episodic tabular MDPs, plus numerical experiments on regret and local switching cost.
S4NN33LI06.claimed_gains: not stated numerically; the abstract claims the first fine-grained gap-dependent regret bound for variance-aware model-free RL, the best-known gap-dependent local switching cost, and improved worst-case guarantees over UCB-Bernstein.

9anJkPeyEc.one_liner: Factorizes KV states into binary codes and decoding matrices so attention runs on packed bits without dequantization.
9anJkPeyEc.problem: Quantized KV caches must still be dequantized or unpacked into wider operands for attention, adding conversion overhead and limiting the benefit of low-bit storage.
9anJkPeyEc.method: PiCoKV is a training-free, data-aware method that factorizes keys and values into binary codes and compact decoding matrices, then folds the matrices into attention's query and output paths. Query-key scoring and value aggregation then run directly on packed codes through word-level bitwise operations.
9anJkPeyEc.key_idea: Fold the decoding matrices into the query and output paths so scoring and aggregation operate directly on packed binary codes with bitwise operations.
9anJkPeyEc.evidence: Long-context benchmarks on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B against low-bit quantization baselines, and end-to-end decoding throughput compared with FlashAttention-2.
9anJkPeyEc.claimed_gains: Accuracy comparable to full attention, with end-to-end decoding throughput reaching 3.45x that of FlashAttention-2 at a 256K setting.

UyNKm8dbZE.one_liner: Learns which layers refresh retrieval and which reuse earlier KV-block indices in hybrid attention, via dense-to-sparse distillation.
UyNKm8dbZE.problem: Hybrid-attention prefilling is limited by its full-attention budget, and existing cross-layer reuse methods follow fixed or heuristic schedules.
UyNKm8dbZE.method: ReFresh learns a binary Anchor/Reuse map across layers through dense-to-sparse distillation with the language model frozen. Anchor slots run full attention, derive block scores and cache selected KV-block indices per query block, while Reuse slots attend sparsely using the latest indices from an earlier Anchor of the same KV head.
UyNKm8dbZE.key_idea: A learned binary Anchor/Reuse schedule lets only Anchor layers do full attention and cache KV-block indices that later Reuse layers of the same KV head reuse.
UyNKm8dbZE.evidence: The abstract is truncated before the experiments; only the training setup (frozen language model, dense-to-sparse distillation) is stated.

C4R7Rl6m2n.one_liner: A K-line diffusion transformer pretrained on candlestick data that forecasts by generating future OHLCV paths with flow matching.
C4R7Rl6m2n.problem: Candlestick forecasting has very low signal-to-noise and heterogeneous markets, autoregressive models accumulate error, and general time-series foundation models are not tailored to k-line data.
C4R7Rl6m2n.method: KiT reformulates prediction as conditional path generation via flow matching: given a historical context window, it generates an ensemble of plausible future OHLCV trajectories. It is pre-trained at multiple parameter scales on billions of candlestick bars across multiple markets and timescales.
C4R7Rl6m2n.key_idea: Replace autoregressive forecasting with flow-matching generation of whole future OHLCV trajectories conditioned on a historical window, using a diffusion transformer.
C4R7Rl6m2n.evidence: Pre-training on billions of candlestick bars, with evaluation across three markets and seven resolutions against task-specific financial forecasters and general time-series foundation models.
C4R7Rl6m2n.claimed_gains: A mean return RankIC of 0.057 and a mean volatility RankIC of 0.66, leading at every timescale across three markets and seven resolutions.

IpaGueuAft.one_liner: Aligns EEG with visual features via multi-teacher distillation plus contrastive learning, and recalibrates informative time intervals.
