YktbTmReXm.method: BiTempo performs test-time latent inference over a slow-adapting global distribution (variables, operators, composition) and a fast-adapting local distribution (residual-informed refinements) to condition LM generation and parent retrieval, using a lightweight utility surrogate to rank latent proposals without LM fine-tuning.
YktbTmReXm.key_idea: Factorized global and local latent generation-preference distributions update at two timescales from evaluated equation residuals and are pre-ranked by a lightweight utility surrogate before LM calls.
YktbTmReXm.evidence: Evaluated on the four LSR-Synth domains of LLM-SRBench with Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-4B (400 candidates) and on measured stress-strain data, plus ablations.
YktbTmReXm.claimed_gains: Improves domain-averaged Acc@0.01 on LSR-Synth from 25.79% to 52.81% with Llama-3.1-8B and from 24.58% to 34.08% with Qwen3-4B, and reduces ID and OOD NMSE on stress-strain data by 48.6% and 61.0%.

0gvYw0SdE8.one_liner: Unifies LLM RL algorithms via generalized f-divergence trust regions paired with improved divergence estimator topologies.
0gvYw0SdE8.problem: PPO's degenerate clipping proxy causes premature clipping and poor exploration in LLM RL, while recent variants rely on fragmented heuristic fixes.
0gvYw0SdE8.method: GPPO formulates a generalized f-divergence trust-region theory with a monotonic improvement guarantee and pairs it with estimator topologies that estimate divergences more faithfully than single-sample Monte Carlo, subsuming PPO, DAPO, DPPO, and RIPO in a Divergence x Estimator design space.
0gvYw0SdE8.key_idea: A generalized f-divergence trust-region objective combined with multi-topology divergence estimators unifies LLM RL algorithms across a two-dimensional divergence-and-estimator design space.
0gvYw0SdE8.evidence: Theoretical monotonic improvement guarantee and experiments across eight competition-level math and coding benchmarks.
0gvYw0SdE8.claimed_gains: The best-performing GPPO instantiation surpasses standard GRPO by up to 50% on math and 14% on coding benchmarks.

HAVzulhKry.one_liner: Optimizes a learnable environment latent at test time on a frozen robotic world model using few interactions.
HAVzulhKry.problem: Robotic world models cannot predict action outcomes accurately when unobservable environmental properties like friction, mass, or rules vary across deployments.
HAVzulhKry.method: T2-z augments a robotic world model with a learnable conditioning latent trained via alternating stages (updating the world model with fixed latents, then optimizing latents with a frozen world model). At test time, it freezes the world model and optimizes a fresh latent from one or more interactions.
HAVzulhKry.key_idea: Alternating world-model and latent training induces an unsupervised environment latent space that can be optimized from a few test-time interactions while keeping the world model frozen.
HAVzulhKry.evidence: Evaluated across 7 simulated settings and 4 real-world robotic tasks against a Standard World Model baseline.
HAVzulhKry.claimed_gains: Reduces task-normalized mean physical error by 54.60% relative to the Standard World Model and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%.

ijwMrgp1Bw.one_liner: Enhances MLLM affective reasoning without training via hierarchical soft-gated reasoning and contrastive discriminative visual pruning.
ijwMrgp1Bw.problem: MLLMs dilute subtle emotional cues during global reasoning and fail to isolate visual regions that distinguish semantically proximal emotions.
ijwMrgp1Bw.method: Decoding Affective Nuances (DAN) is a training-free inference-time framework combining a Hierarchical Emotional Reasoning Chain (HERC), which harmonizes scene- and object-level cues via soft-gated reasoning, with Contrastive Discriminative Visual Pruning (CDVP) to separate semantically similar emotions.
ijwMrgp1Bw.key_idea: Combine soft-gated scene/object hierarchical emotional reasoning with training-free contrastive discriminative visual pruning at inference time.

yFskqfP4mX.one_liner: Watermarks unlabeled SSL text datasets with adaptive global styles and recipient fingerprints for black-box leakage tracing.
yFskqfP4mX.problem: Conventional dataset watermarks rely on label supervision, break under strong semi-supervised learning augmentations, and cannot trace leaked copies to specific recipients.
yFskqfP4mX.method: GSPS selects unlabeled watermark carriers via EFS-chi-squared selection for classification or multi-model cooperation for LLM reasoning and QA. It then uses Quad-Dimensional Adaptive Style Selection (QASS) to choose robust global styles embedded with semantically separated recipient fingerprints for black-box statistical ownership verification and leakage attribution.
yFskqfP4mX.key_idea: Select unlabeled carriers without annotations, choose robust global watermark styles via QASS, and embed recipient-specific fingerprints for black-box attribution.
yFskqfP4mX.evidence: Evaluated across Chinese and English datasets and multiple semi-supervised learning algorithms.

ZCSSwGvC9A.one_liner: Interleaves hierarchical Semantic ID decoding with on-demand tool-based feature acquisition in generative retrieval.
ZCSSwGvC9A.problem: Static feature injection in generative retrieval increases serving cost, introduces conflicting signals, and cannot adaptively decide when or where features should guide decoding.
ZCSSwGvC9A.method: Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR) conditions on the request and decoded Semantic ID (SID) prefix to decide whether to invoke a feature tool, which feature to fetch, and where its observation steers subsequent SID branching. It is trained via SID pretraining followed by tool-augmented fine-tuning on trajectories built from feature applicability and information gain.
ZCSSwGvC9A.key_idea: Condition on the decoded Semantic ID prefix to trigger on-demand feature tool calls supervised by information-gain trajectories along the SID hierarchy.
ZCSSwGvC9A.evidence: Evaluated on an industrial dataset, three public benchmarks, and an online A/B test.

BQHMd3cyw8.one_liner: Learns a lightweight router over a frozen video generator to composite non-contiguous historical KV-cache mosaics.
BQHMd3cyw8.problem: Autoregressive video generators lose fine-grained visual details of objects or scenes once they leave the finite context window and later reappear.
BQHMd3cyw8.method: MosaiChunk keeps the video generator frozen and trains a lightweight router to select non-contiguous spatio-temporal historical KV entries into a fixed-budget memory mosaic. The authors also introduce RememBench with prompt-driven T2V and camera-driven I2V long-horizon revisit splits.
BQHMd3cyw8.key_idea: Keep the video generator frozen and train a lightweight router to assemble a fixed-budget mosaic of non-contiguous historical KV entries.
BQHMd3cyw8.evidence: Evaluated on RememBench across T2V and I2V settings against sliding-window inference and whole-chunk retrieval under matched memory budgets.

85mwmrCJlA.one_liner: Trains VLM embodied planners to self-correct action sequences against calibrated imagined visual consequences before execution.
85mwmrCJlA.problem: Embodied VLM agents generate linguistically plausible action plans that fail during execution because they neglect visual action consequences.
85mwmrCJlA.method: Self-Correcting Imaginative Planning (SCIP) combines imagination-guided policy learning, which grounds VLM planning in imagined visual outcomes before execution, with verification-driven imagination learning to calibrate imagined consequences to true environment dynamics.
85mwmrCJlA.key_idea: Pair imagination-guided policy learning with verification-driven imagination calibration so VLM planners revise infeasible plans before execution.
85mwmrCJlA.evidence: Evaluated against existing embodied VLM agents across multiple embodied planning tasks.

ygjE3SAcfp.one_liner: Certifies unlearning in logistic regression using local loss-landscape distance bounds without strong regularization.
ygjE3SAcfp.problem: Certified unlearning methods based on Newton-step error bounds require heavy regularization and ignore data anisotropy, degrading accuracy or triggering frequent retrains.
ygjE3SAcfp.method: UNCLE (Unlearning Certifiably via Local Estimates) bounds the distance between any initial unlearning estimate and the ideal retrained model using only local properties of the loss landscape. This enables calibrated noise addition under mild regularization and non-isotropic data.
ygjE3SAcfp.key_idea: Bound the distance from an approximate unlearned model to the exact retrained optimum using local loss-landscape properties rather than global Newton bounds.
ygjE3SAcfp.evidence: Evaluated on certified machine unlearning for logistic regression against prior certified unlearning methods.

a3laGOUIu7.one_liner: Injects a timestep-conditioned bias into Diffusion Transformer attention gates to preserve early-step text conditioning on OOD prompts.
a3laGOUIu7.problem: Diffusion Transformers trained on structured prompts degrade on free-form out-of-domain prompts due to attention sinks and weakened early-step image-to-text attention.
a3laGOUIu7.method: After showing that standard gated attention suppresses sinks but still reduces early-step image-to-text attention, the authors propose Timestep-Aware Gated Attention (TSGate). TSGate injects a timestep-conditioned bias into the gate signal so gating adapts across denoising steps.
a3laGOUIu7.key_idea: Add a timestep-conditioned bias to the attention gate signal so Diffusion Transformer gating adapts across denoising steps.
a3laGOUIu7.evidence: Evaluated against baseline and standard gated attention Diffusion Transformers across multiple benchmarks, including raw-prompt DPG.
a3laGOUIu7.claimed_gains: Improves raw-prompt DPG by 9.5% over the baseline.

uf5cm0jlDp.one_liner: Adds a subgoal progress pointer to frozen VLA policies that advances only on physically verified grasp and placement outcomes.
uf5cm0jlDp.problem: Frozen vision-language-action policies run open-loop without progress tracking, while naive memory that records attempted actions turns transient failures into persistent state errors.
uf5cm0jlDp.method: Achievement-Grounded Memory (AGM) pairs a static subgoal sequence and dynamic progress pointer with a frozen VLA, tracker, and encoder. Proprioceptive gripper-load cues trigger verification: coherent point tracking verifies grasps, and a single trained 2.43M-parameter cross-view comparison head verifies placements before advancing the pointer.
uf5cm0jlDp.key_idea: Advance a subgoal pointer for frozen VLA policies only upon physical verification via gripper-load triggers, point tracking, and a 2.43M-parameter placement head.
uf5cm0jlDp.evidence: Evaluated on the RoboMME Counting benchmark (including PickXTimes and BinFill) and transferred to a physical robot.
uf5cm0jlDp.claimed_gains: Reaches 100.0% on PickXTimes and 84.0% on BinFill in RoboMME Counting, surpassing the strongest memory-augmented baseline by 7.7 points on the four-task average, and achieves 100.0% and 82.0% on a physical robot.

BjsV3exEKv.one_liner: Uses persistence-aware directed SFT to make computer-use agents embed dormant attack payloads inside self-synthesized artifacts.
BjsV3exEKv.problem: Existing computer-use agent defenses assume external, temporally bounded attacks and overlook internal compromise propagating through persistent agent-generated skills and memory.
BjsV3exEKv.method: SynChain applies persistence-aware directed supervised fine-tuning so agents hide dormant payloads within structural redundancies of benign-looking self-synthesized artifacts that later reactivate as trusted context. The authors also build CUAChain, covering five workflow categories, up to five-subtask chains, and three attack objectives.
BjsV3exEKv.key_idea: Train computer-use agents via persistence-aware directed SFT to embed dormant payloads in self-synthesized skills and memory that reactivate in later workflows.
BjsV3exEKv.evidence: Conducts over 6,000 end-to-end executions on CUAChain across OpenClaw, Codex, and Claude Code under four defense settings.
BjsV3exEKv.claimed_gains: Achieves over 93% attack success in single-hop propagation across OpenClaw, Codex, and Claude Code under four defense settings.

1TZlQ9UoVO.one_liner: Exposes simplex membership leakage via local neighborhood comparison attacks and mitigates it with dynamic topological perturbation.
1TZlQ9UoVO.problem: Boundary operators and Hodge Laplacians in Simplicial Complex Neural Networks encode training-simplex cues that create membership inference privacy risks.
1TZlQ9UoVO.method: The authors introduce Structure-Aware Black-Box (SA-BB), which compares a queried simplex's API prediction probabilities against public-topology neighbors and trains a shadow-model membership classifier on local response patterns. To defend against leakage, Dynamic Topological Pruning and Injection (DTPI) perturbs selected high-impact topological relations during training.
1TZlQ9UoVO.key_idea: Infer target membership from prediction differences against public topological neighbors and defend by pruning and injecting high-impact topological relations during training.
1TZlQ9UoVO.evidence: Evaluates membership leakage and privacy-utility trade-offs across datasets, simplicial neural network backbones, and defenses.

7wQbciKJ3u.one_liner: Represents long-form video clips as multi-view short phrases retrieved via phrase-wise maximum scoring.
7wQbciKJ3u.problem: Compressing video clips into single query-agnostic captions with lightweight VLMs omits fine-grained cues needed for downstream long-form video QA.
7wQbciKJ3u.method: MVP-Mem extracts compact, independently retrievable short phrases per video clip under complementary semantic views instead of generating full narrative captions. At query time, clips are retrieved using a phrase-wise maximum scoring rule before passing evidence to the answer generator.
7wQbciKJ3u.key_idea: Index each video clip with independently retrievable short phrases extracted under complementary semantic views and score clips by phrase-wise maximum.
7wQbciKJ3u.evidence: Evaluated across four long-form video QA benchmarks (including EgoLifeQA) using Qwen3-VL-4B for both phrase and caption memory construction with the same answer generator.
7wQbciKJ3u.claimed_gains: Raises four-benchmark average accuracy over the caption baseline from 44.5% to 54.0% (+9.5 percentage points) and nearly halves memory construction time on EgoLifeQA.

ki2lre0LFt.one_liner: Allocates 3D Gaussian capacity to high-error native-resolution regions using Eckart-Young-Mirsky distortion and hybrid support.
ki2lre0LFt.problem: Unrestricted native high-resolution 3D Gaussian Splatting refinement allocates primitives indiscriminately, causing excessive primitive growth and high memory cost.
ki2lre0LFt.method: MarginalGS addresses region-wise representation imbalance by estimating where added capacity reduces error and focusing native-resolution supervision there. It quantifies rank-2 covariance distortion on refined primitives via the Eckart-Young-Mirsky error and uses resolution and reliability to select hybrid support.
ki2lre0LFt.key_idea: Concentrate native-resolution supervision where added capacity reduces error and select hybrid Gaussian support using Eckart-Young-Mirsky covariance distortion, resolution, and reliability.
ki2lre0LFt.evidence: Evaluated across four native-6K indoor datasets and three native-5K outdoor scenes on SSIM, ROI PSNR, full-image PSNR, and total memory.

uGCpsZ8I2O.one_liner: Guides LLM heuristic co-evolution using solver-instance interaction residuals, bidirectional validation, and structured evidence memory.
uGCpsZ8I2O.problem: Scalar performance feedback in LLM-based automated algorithm design conflates overall solver weakness, general instance difficulty, and specific solver-instance interactions.
uGCpsZ8I2O.method: Interaction-Aware Co-Evolution (IACE) builds a solver-instance performance matrix and extracts interaction residuals after removing average solver and instance effects to form targeted hypotheses. It verifies parent-child heuristics via bidirectional controlled validation across paired original and modified instances and stores validated versus unverified records in a structured evidence memory.
uGCpsZ8I2O.key_idea: Extract solver-instance interaction residuals from a performance matrix, test heuristic edits via paired bidirectional validation, and reuse validated findings from structured memory.

0v4s00VQIr.one_liner: Conditions a flow-matching quadrupedal locomotion policy on latent actuator-effectiveness context inferred from interaction history.
0v4s00VQIr.problem: Actuator torque degradation alters closed-loop robot dynamics and cannot be observed from instantaneous proprioception, breaking nominal locomotion policies.
0v4s00VQIr.method: HAFT performs online system identification by inferring latent joint actuator effectiveness from recent observation-action history and selectively aggregating temporal context based on current state and degradation condition. A flow-matching policy conditioned on this context generates adapted whole-body joint actions.
0v4s00VQIr.key_idea: Infer latent actuator effectiveness from recent observation-action history and condition a flow-matching policy on state- and degradation-aggregated temporal context.
0v4s00VQIr.evidence: Evaluated on quadrupedal locomotion across diverse actuator degradation patterns and severities.

lKG6PrgDyl.one_liner: Optimizes MLLM emotion reasoning via VAD emotional distribution priors and a leave-one-out marginal diversity reward.
lKG6PrgDyl.problem: RL algorithms like GRPO rely on hard-label supervision and point-wise evaluation, causing poor generalization, weak subjective coverage, and visual hallucinations in MLLM emotional reasoning.
lKG6PrgDyl.method: DSPO constructs a context-grounded emotional distribution prior in valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) space by combining lexical emotion priors with image-specific context. It introduces a Distribution-Aligned Emotional Diversity Reward (DEDR) that scores each candidate emotion in a rollout by its leave-one-out marginal contribution toward matching the prior.
lKG6PrgDyl.key_idea: Constructs an image-conditioned VAD emotional distribution prior and rewards rollout candidates by their leave-one-out marginal contribution to distribution coverage.

Jzb31Lw4EY.one_liner: Enables real-time one-step streaming video restoration via mask-free shifted-window dense attention and a lightweight autoencoder.
Jzb31Lw4EY.problem: One-step diffusion video restoration models struggle on consumer GPUs due to quadratic spatial attention at high resolutions and heavy video autoencoder latency and memory.
Jzb31Lw4EY.method: SwiftVR operates under a causal chunk-wise streaming protocol using mask-free shifted-window self-attention that gathers spatial windows via deterministic indexing onto dense scaled dot-product attention without masks, padding, or custom sparse kernels, paired with a lightweight Restoration-aware Autoencoder.
Jzb31Lw4EY.key_idea: Uses deterministic indexing to map shifted-window spatial attention onto dense SDPA without masks or custom kernels, paired with a lightweight chunk-wise restoration autoencoder.
Jzb31Lw4EY.evidence: Throughput and memory benchmarks on single H100 and RTX 5090 GPUs across 1080p, 2K (2560x1440), and 4K (3840x2160) resolutions compared against diffusion-based VR baselines.
Jzb31Lw4EY.claimed_gains: Sustains 54 FPS at 1080p, 31 FPS at 2560x1440 (2K), and 14 FPS at 3840x2160 (4K) on a single H100 (where compared baselines OOM at 4K), and 26 FPS at 1080p on an RTX 5090.

SeOuSAh1p3.one_liner: Learns incomplete multi-view clustering consensus via reliability-gated fusion, entropy-regularized optimal transport, and prototype supervision.
SeOuSAh1p3.problem: Missing views, heterogeneous view distributions, and unequal view quality hinder learning consistent semantic representations in incomplete multi-view clustering.
SeOuSAh1p3.method: PRSCL uses a reliability-aware gating mechanism for instance-level weighted fusion of available views into consensus representations and semantic prototypes without explicit view imputation. It then computes soft sample-to-prototype assignments via entropy-regularized optimal transport and enforces cross-view clustering consistency through bidirectional mutual supervision.
SeOuSAh1p3.key_idea: Combines reliability-gated instance-level view fusion with entropy-regularized optimal transport to consensus semantic prototypes and bidirectional cross-view mutual supervision.
SeOuSAh1p3.evidence: Experiments on benchmark datasets under various missing-view conditions.

5Re0oRGZgn.one_liner: Trains a single shared ViT for audio-visual self-supervised learning using modality dropout and SIGReg collapse prevention.
5Re0oRGZgn.problem: Audio-visual self-supervised methods typically depend on complex components such as EMA teachers, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, or contrastive negatives.
5Re0oRGZgn.method: LeAVJEPA trains a single early-fusion Vision Transformer on audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs under LeJEPA's objective. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view to implicitly align modalities by matching a joint global embedding with modality-specific local embeddings, while SIGReg prevents collapse.
5Re0oRGZgn.key_idea: Uses modality dropout in a single shared early-fusion ViT to align joint global and modality-specific local embeddings under SIGReg without teachers, decoders, or contrastive negatives.
5Re0oRGZgn.evidence: Evaluated on AudioSet-20K, ESC-50 (frozen evaluation), VGGSound (fine-tuning), zero-shot audio-video retrieval, training throughput vs. MJEPA, and a controlled ablation of modality dropout.
5Re0oRGZgn.claimed_gains: Reaches 42.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 95.5% accuracy on ESC-50 (frozen) at 2.8x the training throughput of MJEPA, and 64.2% fine-tuned accuracy on VGGSound.

vowUua5HhN.one_liner: Generates irregular time series via coarse-to-fine hierarchical flow matching over counts, timestamps, observation masks, and values.
vowUua5HhN.problem: Time series generative models typically assume regular temporal grids or fixed sampling structures, failing to generate native irregular time series with variable observation counts, times, and co-observation patterns.
vowUua5HhN.method: ChronoFlow factorizes irregular time series generation into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical flow-matching pipeline: first generating observation counts and feature frequencies, then jointly generating timestamps and feature co-observation patterns, and finally generating feature values conditioned on the realized pattern. The paper also introduces evaluation metrics validated via controlled corruptions.
vowUua5HhN.key_idea: Decomposes irregular time series synthesis into three coarse-to-fine flow-matching stages generating counts/frequencies, timestamps/co-observation patterns, and conditioned feature values.
vowUua5HhN.evidence: Evaluated across five benchmarks with factorization studies and controlled-corruption metric validation.

R46sid3aAT.one_liner: Detects out-of-distribution graphs without labels using multi-scale temporal aggregation of local structural resonance.
R46sid3aAT.problem: Unsupervised graph OOD detectors based on single-period optimization-induced representation dynamics underutilize graph structure and are sensitive to stochastic noise and transient gradients.
R46sid3aAT.method: Multi-Scale Structural Resonance Estimation (MSRE) models local structural resonance on graphs and aggregates it across multiple temporal scales during optimization. It pairs this with a consistency-based candidate selection strategy requiring no labeled validation set.
R46sid3aAT.key_idea: Aggregates local graph structural resonance across multiple optimization timescales and selects candidates via consistency without a labeled validation set.
R46sid3aAT.evidence: Evaluated on multiple benchmark graphs against unsupervised graph OOD detection baselines.

dKsTYtRRcA.one_liner: Compresses LLM attention sequentially using structured Tucker decomposition over Q/K/V heads and separate output-projection adaptation.
dKsTYtRRcA.problem: Independent matrix approximation for post-training LLM attention compression ignores shared structure across Q/K/V projections and representation shifts caused by compressing earlier layers.
dKsTYtRRcA.method: FTC sequentially compresses attention layers by adapting each approximation to the already-compressed model while jointly exploiting native Q/K/V head structure via structured Tucker decomposition under a fixed storage budget, then handles the output projection separately without fine-tuning or gradient-based recovery.
dKsTYtRRcA.key_idea: Applies sequential structured Tucker decomposition jointly across Q/K/V heads adapted to prior compression shifts, followed by separate output-projection compression without fine-tuning.
dKsTYtRRcA.evidence: Evaluated on seven decoder-only LLMs (6B to 32B parameters, including five modern GQA models) using WikiText-2 perplexity and downstream tasks across multiple keep ratios.
dKsTYtRRcA.claimed_gains: Achieves the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity among compared methods at every tested keep ratio on five modern GQA models.

6BJWCmavmf.one_liner: Learns frequency-regularized hierarchical continuous latent actions from videos and transfers them to VLA policies via joint flow matching.
6BJWCmavmf.problem: Reconstruction-oriented latent actions learned from action-free videos often encode static scene appearance or entangle slow task progress with fine execution dynamics in limited discrete codes.
6BJWCmavmf.method: FreshVLA applies a high-pass prior to focus visual transition encoding on dynamical regions and uses cross-timescale sampling with frequency-domain regularization to separate coarse task progress from fine execution dynamics in continuous latent actions. During policy training, the frozen encoder is transferred to robot control via joint flow matching of latent and robot actions.
6BJWCmavmf.key_idea: Uses a high-pass prior, cross-timescale sampling, and frequency regularization to learn hierarchical continuous latent actions transferred via joint latent-robot flow matching.
6BJWCmavmf.evidence: Evaluated on LIBERO, LIBERO-Long (vs. GR00T-N1.6), CALVIN, and zero-shot LIBERO-PLUS.
6BJWCmavmf.claimed_gains: Achieves 98.2% average success on LIBERO, 98.0% on LIBERO-Long (3.6% above GR00T-N1.6), 4.5 average sequence length on CALVIN, and 80.4% overall success on zero-shot LIBERO-PLUS.
